## What is Linkage Lab?
Linkage Lab is a pedagogical tool for exploring and understanding how marker linkage affects likelihood ratios (LRs) in kinship testing. It is a companion to [KLINK](https://magnusdv.github.io/pedsuite/articles/web_only/klink.html), which is a full-featured software for kinship testing, including support for linkage.

Linkage Lab is described in detail in the KLINK paper: [KLINK: A program for kinship testing with pairwise linked STR markers](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.fsigen.2026.103578) (Vigeland and Gilfillan, 2026).
